instruction: Candid street photograph, medium close-up shot. On a city street during the day, the woman in the white halter maxi dress (R2) on the left and the person in the light blue denim jacket (R1) on the right run side-by-side. Both smile happily and look forward, showing off colorful pride makeup on their faces. They hold hands, which are partially visible at the bottom of the frame. The background is a softly blurred city street with buildings and traffic lights. Warm, natural daylight illuminates their joyful faces.
